title: Samuel Goes to the Temple
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart, and tonight little Samuel bravely lives at the temple away from his mother: Beau stays brave on his first day at a new school.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because doing a hard thing far from Mom takes a big, brave heart. In Beau’s world today: it is his first day at a new school, and his tummy feels wobbly. At the door, Mom gives him a hug, and then she has to go. Beau wants to run after her. Instead he squeezes his own shoulders tight, takes a big breath, and walks in to find his teacher. By lunchtime he has a new friend. Just like little Samuel at the temple, Beau learned that Heavenly Father helps you be brave when you do the hard, right thing.
